item.title: Show HN: Serve Nix closures to k8s pods (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
item.description: I've been working on a Nix CSI for kubernetes since NixCon when I realized that everyone seems to working towards killing OCI layers (and images) in Kubernetes deployments. I'm hoping to get people to give it a spin and report back to me bugs, feature requests or general feedback. I don't have a lot of data on how this scales and that makes it hard to decide whether to justify adding a feature or not (e.g. cache locality scheduling). An LLM was used in the development of this project. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50136139 Points: 1 # Comments: 0

item.title: Show HN: Esp32sim - Run ESP32 firmware in the browser (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
item.description: Hi HN, I've been working on esp32sim, an open-source ESP32 emulator that runs in the browser. The fun part of the demo is that there is no ESP32 involved - the firmware is executing in the emulator. The goal is to make ESP32 software easier to experiment with, test and simulate without always needing physical hardware connected. Source: https://github.com/mikroverk/esp32sim I made a short video showing it in action: https://youtu.be/waoWFilTWEc I'm particularly interested in feedback from embedded developers: what would an emulator like this need to support before you'd actually use it for development, testing or CI? Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50131189 Points: 110 # Comments: 11
